programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Hunters [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: An unexplained phenomenon has struck the Earth. Contact between most towns on Earth has been severed. A small area in Eastern Europe is the only location that still has electricity. When military forces venture outside, they discover a shocking truth - corpses everywhere. In stores, in cars, on roads, in hospitals and railway stations. Who or what is destroying all life on Earth? And how long can the last outpost of mankind endure?

programme.desc: Tricia says her 12-year-old daughter, Rebecca Ann, tragically took her own life in 2013 after being cyberbullied. Now, Tricia claims she not only is being harassed online by a stranger –who shares the same name as her deceased daughter --but she also is being accused of the unthinkable. Tempers flare when the women come face to face for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. How can Tricia move forward in peace and finally grieve her daughter’s loss?

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional
programme.desc: Watch as the formidable mother-daughter duo, Lee and Anna Leigh Waters, take on challengers from North Carolina in this Pro Women's Doubles match from the US National Pickleball Center. After an injury, it is great to see the champions partner up again, demonstrating the "fire and ice" style of play that has made them national champions. While the Waters team's game one was a quick 11-point victory, the challengers, Fuzesi and Maloof, handled themselves well on the championship court. The players at home can learn from Anna Leigh's "instigator" shots and two-handed backhand rolls, which she helped bring to the big stage.

programme.title: Secrets of the North Sea
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tricia says her 12-year-old daughter, Rebecca Ann, tragically took her own life in 2013 after being cyberbullied. Now, Tricia claims she not only is being harassed online by a stranger –who shares the same name as her deceased daughter --but she also is being accused of the unthinkable. Tempers flare when the women come face to face for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. How can Tricia move forward in peace and finally grieve her daughter’s loss?

programme.desc: Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. Sin embargo, el pequeño perro de los Pitufos se dedica a escarbar entre las flores de Pitufina, ensuciar el nuevo papel pintado de Pitufo Vanidoso y arruinar los experimentos de Papá Pitufo. Aun así, Puppy va a ayudar a los Pitufos a escapar de una trampa que les ha tendido Gargamel. O quizá no tenga la disciplina necesaria para ello…

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Cartoon for kids about helper cars: a fire truck, an ambulance, a police car and a tow truck. Why these cars and trucks are useful? Because they help people and other cars: fire truck can put out fire, ambulance helps people, when they are hurt or sick, it could drive them to the hospital. Police car patrols the city. Tow truck help other cars, when they are broken down. Watch new car cartoon and learn about helper cars!

Who or what is destroying all life on Earth? And how long can the last outpost of mankind endure?

programme.title: Into The Blue
programme.desc: Colten & Mark Scroggins is in Oklahoma during the peak rut, chasing mature whitetail bucks! With bucks on the move and searching for does, it's the perfect time to break out the calls. Watch as Mark and Colten pull out all the stops—getting aggressively loud with the WoodHaven "Intimidator" Grunt Call—to turn a cruising buck and bring him right into bow range at the blind.

programme.title: When Tyrants Rule the World
programme.desc: In the early days of the Cold War, the Soviet blockade of Berlin prompts a humanitarian airlift of monumental proportions. As the United States enters the Korean Conflict, Air Forcefliers battle for air superiority against the fastest, most maneuverable jets in the world: Soviet MIGS. Against this backdrop, American and Soviet scientists make enormous advances in missile technology, and international geopolitics becomes a game of stalemate.
